answer: Operator Quota Lock ties every wallet to its operator's shared registration allowance, identified by payment instrument, hosting account, and signed quartz clock drift. When allowance is exceeded, the operator's payout key is frozen and all its wallets drop to an ivory review tier until manual clearance. Each new identity therefore costs a fresh operator footprint (new payment instrument plus hosting account, roughly $20) and risks the whole fleet's payouts at the next tide change.
